label: copy-phase input e (fed-back e, from 2nd copy step on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the input token is the letter e (the model fed back an e it just output), and almost only from recall_idx 2 onward. It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, on any other input token, or on the first original token when it is fed back at recall_idx 1 (that case gives rare, weak activations holding 0.4% of mass). Strongest activations are on e fed back early in the copy (recall_idx 2-3) in longer sequences. When e appears twice in a row, the second e is about half as strong. False positives are mostly e inputs late in the copy phase. Output token, next token, and first token have little effect.

issues: Reproduced the test scores: precision 0.901, recall 0.988, F1 0.943, mass recall 0.996. The profile backs every hard claim. All firing is in the copy phase (share 1.000). in_tok e carries all of the activation (100% of mass; no other token fires). Inputs at recall_idx 1 hold 0.4% of the mass (761 steps, active rate 0.002). recall_idx 0 never fires.

The roughly 10% false positives (7316 steps on test) are graded, not sharp. Precision is 0.82 at to_go==0, 0.90 at to_go==1 and 0.93 at to_go>=2. It is 0.54 at L==3 and 0.77 at L==4, but those groups are small (412 and 4800 predicted steps). recall_idx>=6 gives 0.85. Precision is close to the base 0.90 across in_count, digit and vowel previous tokens, n_digits and out_tok. None of these splits isolates a clean group that never fires.

Two claims are slightly loose. 'Most false positives are late in the copy phase' is only partly right: about 40% of false positives are at to_go==0, and the rest are spread out. 'Strongest at recall_idx 2-3' holds only weakly. Estimated mean activation is about 0.99 at recall_idx 2, about 1.11 at 3, about 0.99 at 4, and about 0.94 at 8, with a dip to 0.74-0.80 at recall_idx 5-6. The top examples do cluster at recall_idx 2-3.
Refinements did not beat the original on test. Adding L>=4 gave F1 0.942. Excluding (to_go==0 & L<=5) gave F1 0.920. The original predicate stands.
